doc.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Assembling the Hollywood team
summary: Roger Kellaway conducted, Greg McRitchie orchestrated, and Dan Wallin's studio gave him a dream first film experience.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: No kidding. I would have been very anxious going in front of a symphony orchestra of L.A. musicians, being it was the first time that you’d done that.

Well what I did is I was realistic. I amassed a wonderful team. And here I have to really thank Roger Kellaway, who had been doing movie scores for a number of years down there, and I called Roger and I said, “look I’ve got this opportunity, I don’t know a damn thing about how Hollywood works with this stuff, who do I need here?” So it ended up Roger conducted the orchestra for me, because I’d had no experience conducting at all, I got Greg McRitchie to do the orchestration, because he was a seasoned orchestrator who didn’t have an ego, so he didn’t have to feel he had to change any note. So I wrote out, in the orchestral sketch, every note that I wanted to hear, but Greg made crucial decisions that I was not qualified to make which would be, I might say I want brass here, but he would decide how many trombones. And do we want French horns here too? And should

trumpets be playing this same note an octave higher? He was a master orchestrator. Did a beautiful job. And I had a top musical editor who prepared the timing sheets for me so I knew just exactly to a tenth of a second how much music was needed in every scene. And a top contractor. So I had a super, super team, the best LA musicians, because again Roger told me all the guys to hire. And I had the best studio, a guy named Dan Wallin in the Burbank Studio, this was the top soundstage. So for a guy doing his first film, I had this Rolls Royce opportunity. And I knew I could do another hundred films and it would never be that good. So that was it man.
Okay. You cannot reproduce that so just concentrate on something else.
